candidate_rule: Fit legacy O-nose spline, tail-regularized O-nose spline, three X-anchored splines, and three upper-plasma-frequency variants (0.4, 0.8, 1.2 MHz at 800 km). If X nose minus O nose is at least 0.55 MHz, X offsets are 0.45, 0.35, 0.25 MHz; otherwise offsets are 0.25, 0.15, 0.05 MHz. Clamp every foF2 anchor to at least O nose plus 0.02 MHz. Broad-tail variants use the central X offset.
selection: minimum full-ray O/X accepted-return score before opening truth density or peak parameters
upper_anchor_note: The three upper-frequency anchors form a generic broad-tail ensemble; this altitude is above the 2 MHz sweep turning height and remains weakly identified.
rule_adjustment_reason: Observed O and X noses were only 0.3 MHz apart; fixed larger X offsets implied foF2 below an accepted O return and were physically infeasible. This correction uses observation frequencies only, before any truth density or peak parameters are opened.
